notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Hi, scouts!

It's time to go trick or treating!

notes.title: Wildlife Big Update
notes.content:
Hi Scouts!

I would like to introduce the "Wildlife Update" for Wind Peaks! We've been hard at work improving our game taking into account your valuable feedback.

Here some of the changes we made:

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/07980a40dd4e52a0407aa5796665445221013754.gif[/img][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img][b]Everything[/b] has a little interaction now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img][b]More than 100 new interactions[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]Removed RTS controls (the camera won't move when the cursor is at the borders of the screen)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]New hidden objects, hidden in better spots that will require you to interact with the scene to find them
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]Is night time on level 12
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]New wild animals
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]Explore inside buildings, tents, and houses
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]New and remastered musics
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]New set of sound effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d646b4faaa35b6f97da34f984f58d747c92fa36c.png[/img]Better hint pin logic

We hope you enjoy :)
Actoon Team

notes.title: 3 Years Anniversary Big Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/52d6166b93618638e2d14c87b349ff38323ec328.png[/img]

It's been an incredible 3 years since the release of Wind Peaks, and we couldn't be more grateful for the everyone in our community! Today, we are happy to present this big Anniversary Update, packed with numerous fixes, revisited content, and improvements, all thanks to your valuable feedback!

What changed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Levels Revisited
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Better hidden objects locations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Houses interiors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] New Soundtrack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Ported many systems from Wind Peaks 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] New rendering system for better performance and compatibility between Intel integrated video and AMD video cards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Use joystick bindings by default when plugged for a better Steam Deck experience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Rework of the hidden object randomizer, hopeful fixing the banana glitch
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Fix walking trees
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/306b926e7dcf6d7fb84f939b9c4ceada0ec0f3ee.png[/img] Ukrainian localizations by darwinwasright & pani_kit

notes.title: Joystick support and bug fixes
Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hello again everyone, today I'm happy to bring you all the first big update for Wind Peaks. Beyond new content many other improvements were made, check it all out below.

[h2]Animated comics[/h2]

It felt too much of the story was open to interpretation, so we added 5 cutscenes in between the levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/a94a0bb0390e11f071756a8480da2134861be205.gif[/img]

[h2]Save Game Feature[/h2]

Or to be better put a "continue where you left of" feature, so now you can exit the game at any point and then continue exactly where you left without the need to redo the level.

This one wasn't easy but we finally got it done.

[h2]Hints![/h2]

Click on the object you wish to find while looking for it and once the timer runs out a hint will
point out towards the object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/d7207d4ddde96a8c749b82d642752ca71fac1835.gif[/img]

[h2]+15 new interactions[/h2]

We added many new interactions, go find them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38186626/97d4059e2c464d66ce9d7f9c54da02b44b148849.gif[/img]

[h2]German Translation[/h2]

Thanks to Markus Schaberreiter a german translation was officially added to the game.

I personally don't understand a word, but it brings me such a joy seeing the game in other languages :)



That’s all everyone,
Stay classy and have a nice day!

Felipe (Paralelepípedo)

notes.title: Translations update and more!
notes.content:
I hope you're all out there doing well. We're back with another update.

For the future we intend to launch content updates and QoL (Quality of Life) for Wind Peak, stay tuned;

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Chinese and Russian translations
[*] Added Support for community translations
[*] Preferences to adjust interface size
[*] Videos are not played on some AMD graphics cards, but this will no longer prevent the game from starting
[/list]

[h2]Community translations[/h2]

Would you like to play Wind Peaks in your native language? In this update we have added the ability for you to create your own translations and / or contribute to official translations and have your name entered in the game credits!

To create your translations just go to this link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vn4krR-lL5qDFGIxANw5yaD77tELw6aWWZjLHhENhKs/edit#gid=1261002054 and follow the instructions.

The Chinese and Russian translations where done by JJ and Kazakov Egor, Thanks!
